::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[How to add paragraph line number in right margin](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/13515/how-to-add-paragraph-line-number-in-right-margin), asked by [yolo](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/3864/yolo) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-03-15; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> In passages, the line numbers are given on the right side of the paragraph. Like this:
> ![enter image description here][q-1]
>
>
>   [q-1]: TTkhD.png
>
> How could this be implemented in LaTeX?
:::

Have a look at the [`lineno`](http://ctan.org/pkg/lineno) package.

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\usepackage[modulo,right]{lineno}
\begin{document}
\linenumbers
\lipsum
\end{document}
```

**Edit** package options suggested by Seamus.
